aboutTk.title:
General information
About the Token
aboutTk.detail: The Aureo Token is part of Febelink's platform ecosystem, helping users to carry out their transactions in a safer, simpler, faster and more efficient way, also having many benefits for use, discounts, and exclusive services.
aboutTk.subtitle: Probably the most usable token in the world
aboutTk.discountsDetail: With Febelink's Aureo Token you automatically get great discounts on the platform, such as Professional and Premium subscriptions, and free services.
aboutTk.exclusiveDetail: Thanks to Febelink's Aureo Token you have access to specific products for the community.
aboutTk.governanceDetail: Having Febelink's Aureo Token gives you the right to participate in many decisions on the platform, such as new products or aid projects.
aboutTk.economyDetail: With Febelink's Aureo Token you can exchange products and services with other users, directly from the token or by changing to any FIAT or Crypto currency.

aboutUs.title: ABOUT US
aboutUs.description: Febelink is a search engine for professional services, a social network where users publish their searches and the system sends notifications to professionals related to the activity. Our goal is to help people more efficiently find the professionals and companies they need, and to help companies and professionals find new clients.

aboutTeam.title: OUR TEAM
aboutTeam.description: Experience and knowledge are identity signs of the people who make up our work group. Join our expanding team.
aboutTeam.juan: Founder & CEO. Entrepreneur with 27 years of experience, developing his career mainly in financial consulting and in the automotive sector.
aboutTeam.david: Co-Founder & CTO. Developer with extensive experience in Cloud systems. He has worked in large public institutions and online auction houses such as: Christie's, Hilco StremBank or LeasePlan.
aboutTeam.miguel: Marketing professional with extensive experience in technology and FMCG. Marketing manager of various multinationals such as Hewlett-Packard or WD-40 Company.
aboutTeam.oscar: Entrepreneur. Creator of alternative Traffic Engineering, Communications Systems, 3D / VR / AR Projects, Satellite Stabilization, etc.
